strip-html-tags.workedExample:
Input:

Hello

World
Again

With Keep line breaks ON: Step 1:
becomes a newline, and a newline is added after each heading and paragraph. Step 2: textContent = "Hello\nWorld\nAgain\n" Step 3: trim -> "Hello\nWorld\nAgain" Output: Hello World Again
mistakes: Expecting links to survive — the anchor text stays but the URLs are gone, so references become useless.
Stripping a table — without structure the cells collapse into an unreadable stream of words.
Assuming images come along — only alt text (if any) remains; the pictures themselves are lost.
Forgetting script and style content — inline JavaScript and CSS can leak into your 'clean' text as junk.
Pasting the result back as HTML — entities were decoded, so characters like < and & can break your page.
